an3.140:1.1: tayo ca bhikkhave, assakhaluṅke desessāmi tayo ca purisakhaluṅke.
an3.140:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaluṅko javasampanno hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.140:2.3: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.140:2.4: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an3.140:3.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaluṅko javasampanno hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.140:3.3: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.140:3.4: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an3.140:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko javasampanno hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
an3.140:4.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu “idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. “ayaṃ dukkhanirodho”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.140:4.4: abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti no vissajjeti.
an3.140:4.6: na kho pana lābhī hoti cīvarapiṇḍapāta senāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
an3.140:4.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko javasampanno hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno, na ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.140:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
an3.140:5.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu “idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.140:5.4: abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṃsādeti.
an3.140:5.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
an3.140:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave, purisakha luṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
an3.140:6.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu “idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.140:6.4: abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṃsādeti.
an3.140:6.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
